description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to approve the absolute Strength Limits of Arrack, Foreign liquor - Milk Punch, Medicinal wine and Malt liquor that comes into effect from 16.12.2015
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification issued under the Excise Ordinance, establishing new regulations for alcohol strength percentages and rescinding previous notifications. It involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for excisable goods, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
